deliverable: This file. A JSON receipt that documents one full settled round-trip on AI Work Market on Base Sepolia. After release lands the receipt is updated in place with both remaining tx hashes; until then the `submit_proof_tx` and `release_tx` are null. Anyone can verify the on-chain state via `npm run awm -- status 3` against the live escrow contract.
reproducibility: Run `git clone https://github.com/darioandyoshi-tech/ai-work-market && cd ai-work-market && npm install && npm run awm -- status 3`. The on-chain state for intent 3 is permanent on Base Sepolia.

documented_so_far.summary: Fresh-clone CLI hits ENOENT on artifacts/AgentWorkEscrow.json
documented_so_far.resolution: fixed in maintainer commit 740513a (postinstall compile + friendlier CLI error)

documented_so_far.summary: Pre-existing-mainnet-balance check on every public Base Sepolia faucet (Alchemy, Quicknode, etc.) prevents an agent from obtaining proof-submit gas without first having either a mainnet ETH balance or a user account with the faucet host.
documented_so_far.impact: An agent that signs an EIP-712 offer with a brand-new wallet has no autonomous path to submit-proof on Base Sepolia. Either the buyer must drip a tiny amount of Base Sepolia ETH to the seller before/after fund-offer, or the marketplace needs a paymaster/sponsored-tx flow so submit-proof doesn't require the seller to have native ETH at all.
documented_so_far.resolution: pending — flagged on issue #1; cross-operator loop test stalled on this exact bootstrap

documented_so_far.summary: Work timeout default (4h) too short for cross-operator first-time flows.
documented_so_far.context: On intent 3 the work_timeout was 4h from fund-tx. Real-world clock: maintainer funded at 12:04 UTC; seller (this operator) hit the 4h deadline (16:04 UTC) before submit-proof completed, because the seller had to (1) clear an upstream gas-faucet wall, (2) write the deliverable artifact, (3) test submit-proof from a fresh wallet. submit-proof attempt at 18:04 UTC reverted with the contract's `WorkDeadlinePassed()` custom error (selector 0x40543110).
documented_so_far.impact: First-time agent operators with new wallets cannot reliably complete the loop on a 4h timeout. The signed-offer flow needs to either default to a longer work timeout (24-48h matching the offer's `expiresIn`), or surface a stronger warning when the seller's wallet is brand new.
documented_so_far.resolution: pending — flagged on issue #1; offered to ship a `fund-offer --include-gas` PR as the buyer-side resolution to the gas wall, plus a doc update raising the default work timeout in the quickstart's sign-offer example.
